environment.description: Rails 7.1 API running on Puma 6.x behind an AWS Application Load Balancer configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication. The ALB listener on port 443 has 'MutualAuthentication' mode set to 'verify' with a custom trust store ARN referencing an ACM PCA-issued intermediate CA. The ALB connection behavior is 'TrustStoreNotFound=deny, ClientCertExpired=deny, ClientCertRevoked=deny, ClientCertUntrusted=deny'. Only requests presenting a valid client certificate chaining to the private CA are forwarded to the target group. The target group uses HTTP on port 3000 (TLS terminated at ALB). Additionally, the EC2 instance security group only allows inbound traffic from the ALB's security group on port 3000. The application's /admin/* routes are only accessible through this ALB. Note: the signal race condition still exists in the code and the USR2 signal is still sent by the sidecar agent for credential rotation purposes.

config.signal_exposure: Same as exploitable - sidecar sends USR2
